sentences.text: Through: Mr. Yasser Sultan Khan, Advocate

Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rahul Bharti, Judge
 Order

The appellant is an owner of vehicle No. JK02AP-5818 (hereinafter referred to as "offending vehicle") which came to meet an accident on 19.05.2015 resulting in the death of its driver - Tofiq Ahmed and one Parvaiz Ahmed, who was at the time of accident travelling in the said vehicle.

The offending vehicle, at the relevant point of time, was owned by the appellant being the registered owner and was a goods' vehicle when it was in the course of its journey purportedly carrying goods for which purpose the deceased- Parvaiz Ahmed was travelling in the said vehicle.

02. The parents, widow, sisters and minor children of the deceased-Parvaiz Ahmed came to petition the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (Principal District & Sessions Judge) Ramban which came to award compensation of an amount of 21,26,800/- along with interest in favour of all the eight claimants, but liability to pay the said compensation amount came to be fastened upon the appellant Cee Kay Traders vs Parveen Begum And Others on 11 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/177202418/
1 as being the register owner of the offending vehicle and excusing the insurer i.e. respondent No. 10 - National Insurance Company Ltd. of its liability.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 03. The appellant being aggrieved has come forward with the present appeal under section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988.

In terms of an order 01.04.2024, this Court came to order stay of execution of the impugned award subject to deposit of the 50% of the awarded amount with the Registry of this Court to be kept and secured as FDR.
04.

The adjudication of the appeal is on a short point as it is not upon question of quantum of compensation awarded to the claimants, but only with respect to placement of the liability upon the appellant instead of the insurer respondent No. 10 - National Insurance Company Ltd. and,
therefore, the contest is going to be between the appellant and the respondent No. 10 - National Insurance Company Ltd. which is yet to be served.
05.

This Court calls upon the appellant to deposit an amount of  5 lac within a period of one month from the date of passing of this order with the Registrar Judicial, Jammu for the sake of its payment to the respondent No. 1 - Parveen Begum, widow of the deceased-Parvaiz Ahmed for enabling her to have some compensation amount in her hand to take care of her person as well as that of her minor son i.e. respondent No. 8 - Shakir Ahmed.

06. In the meantime, appellant is also directed to take steps for effecting service upon the respondent No. 10 -National Insurance Company Ltd. by furnishing registered postal cover with the Registrar Judicial, Jammu within a period of seven days, whereupon notice shall go to the respondent No. 10 - National Insurance Company Ltd.
07.
The amount of  5 lac hereby directed to be deposited by the appellant

, shall be subject to the final outcome of this appeal and in case of displacement of liability from the appellant to the respondent No. 10 - National Insurance Company Ltd., the same shall be recoverable from the respondent No. 10.
08.

Send for the record of file No. 122/Claim of 2015 titled as "Parveen Begum and others Vs National Insurance Company Ltd. and others" from the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (Principal District & Sessions Judge), Ramban disposed of vide award dated 30.12.2023.
09.
